description: Reproduction of Emanuel Leutze's 1851 oil painting 'Washington Crossing the Delaware'. George Washington stands in the bow of a crowded rowboat as soldiers pole and row through ice-choked water; James Monroe is traditionally depicted holding the early American flag behind him. Further boats, horses and troops cross in the background under a hazy sunburst sky.
